BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('signature',p.oid::regprocedure::text,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'acl',p.proacl)) AS graphql_functions FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='graphql_public'; COMMIT;

content.text: {"projectId":"sqaydpbqycvaictieafk","alreadyApplied":false,"result":{"output":"[{\"graphql_functions\":[{\"acl\":[\"=X/supabase_admin\",\"supabase_admin=X/supabase_admin\",\"postgres=X/supabase_admin\",\"anon=X/supabase_admin\",\"authenticated=X/supabase_admin\",\"service_role=X/supabase_admin\"],\"owner\":\"supabase_admin\",\"signature\":\"graphql_public.graphql(text,text,jsonb,jsonb)\",\"definition\":\"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION graphql_public.graphql(\\\"operationName\\\" text DEFAULT NULL::text, query text DEFAULT NULL::text, variables jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, extensions jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)\\n RETURNS jsonb\\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\\nAS $function$\\n            DECLARE\\n                server_version float;\\n            BEGIN\\n                server_version = (SELECT (SPLIT_PART((select version()), ' ', 2))::float);\\n\\n                IF server_version >= 14 THEN\\n                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(\\n                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(\\n                            jsonb_build_object(\\n                                'message', 'pg_graphql extension is not enabled.'\\n                            )\\n                        )\\n                    );\\n                ELSE\\n                    RETURN jsonb_build_object(\\n                        'errors', jsonb_build_array(\\n                            jsonb_build_object(\\n                                'message', 'pg_graphql is only available on projects running Postgres 14 onwards.'\\n                            )\\n                        )\\n                    );\\n                END IF;\\n            END;\\n        $function$\\n\"}]}]","truncated":false}}
